reads: frozen specialist evaluation and the Block II baseline CSV. Does not train or infer.

checkpoints.freeze: <dest>/freeze.json keys runs.<run_id>.best.weights_sha256, family, regime, seed, valid

metrics.reduction: mean over frames, then uniform mean over conditions, then mean over mask replicas 0/1/2
metrics.replicas: mask replicas already averaged; not independent trainings
metrics.package_crosscheck: rmse_K agrees with the fresh reduction within 1e-4 K
metrics.gain_vs_baseline_K: baseline RMSE minus specialist RMSE, same scenario. Positive: specialist lower.
metrics.delta_vs_baseline_K: specialist RMSE minus baseline RMSE, same scenario
metrics.regions: jets T_true < 1800 K; hot zone T >= 2100 K; peak T >= 2200 K. Recomputed from per-frame columns; the numeric package drops them.

fields.error_signed_K: pred_T_K - true_T_K. Predicted T is never rebuilt from the absolute error.
fields.g1_region_mask: bool 128x128 on G1 and N1G1; empty array on the other cells
fields.identity: manifest identity.checkpoint_weights_sha256 equals freeze best weights sha256

baseline.observation_check: surviving_sites_hash equals that baseline run, same cell, role, replica, condition and frame
baseline.legacy_note: Block II panels fig5 cover four seed-0 runs and show |error|. They are not the frame-1000 collection. Missing v1 files are listed in BASELINE_FIELDS_NEEDED.md. No inference is started from this job.

figures.seed_span: min and max across the three training seeds, with the three points drawn. Not a confidence interval.
figures.spatial_variability: mean of the three predicted fields; population std across those fields (ddof=0), labelled as dispersion across trainings; error of the mean field, whose RMSE is not the mean of the three RMSEs

hook.when: after the specialist aggregate job has finished, via $NI_DEST/post_hook.path. Not after training alone.
